newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks firm in light London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks firm in light London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks rose in light trading in London on Tuesday, tracking gains in the U.S. long bond, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 25.98 points at 12,528.68 by 1415 GMT. In Hong Kong the Hang Seng closed down 56.70 points at 12,502.70, on profit-taking and pre-U.S. election jitters.

Traders said the market was quiet ahead of the U.S. election result though gains in U.S. T-bonds helped reverse the market's early losses. "It's really all on the election result and the long bond," said one trader.
By 1430 GMT, the T-bond was up 21/16 at 101.25-26.
HSBC Holdings and Hang Seng Bank provided the main points of interest among Hong Kong shares in London.
HSBC shares were quoted at HK$159.72-1/2 by 1415 GMT, up on their HK$158.50 overnight close. Hang Seng Bank shares were quoted at HK$91.22-1/2, after closing at HK$90.50 in Hong Kong.
